name: modresorts-webcontent
description: ModResorts WebContent - CSS minification build pipeline for AWS CodePipeline + S3 + CloudFront delivery (cr-css-1005)

scripts.minify:css:cleancss: cleancss --level 2 -o WebContent/styles.min.css WebContent/styles.css && cleancss --level 2 -o WebContent/pikaday.min.css WebContent/pikaday.css
scripts.minify:css:cssnano: postcss WebContent/styles.css --use cssnano -o WebContent/styles.min.css && postcss WebContent/pikaday.css --use cssnano -o WebContent/pikaday.min.css
scripts.deploy:s3: aws s3 cp WebContent/styles.min.css s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/static/css/styles.min.css --cache-control 'max-age=31536000,public,immutable' --content-type 'text/css' && aws s3 cp WebContent/pikaday.min.css s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/static/css/pikaday.min.css --cache-control 'max-age=31536000,public,immutable' --content-type 'text/css'
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run deploy:s3 && npm run invalidate:cloudfront

awsPipeline.description: AWS CodePipeline build stage configuration for CSS minification (cr-css-1005) with S3 + CloudFront delivery
awsPipeline.ruleName: CSS Files Not Minified for Production
awsPipeline.remediationStrategy: Integrate CSS Minification in AWS CodePipeline with S3 and CloudFront Delivery
